title: External Cech pure-tensor Leibniz identity
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be schemes and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be structure morphisms. Let $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ and $V:J\to\operatorname{Opens}(Y)$ be arbitrary families, and let $F,G$ be modules on $X,Y$. Write $A^\bullet$ and $B^\bullet$ for their scalar Cech complexes, and write $C^\bullet$ for the scalar Cech complex on $X\times_kY$ with family $W_{ij}=\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V_j$ and coefficients $\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$, as in [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Let $p,q\in\mathbb N$ and let $h:A^p\otimes_kB^q\to C^{p+q}$, $h_1:A^{p+1}\otimes_kB^q\to C^{(p+1)+q}$ and $h_2:A^p\otimes_kB^{q+1}\to C^{p+(q+1)}$ be linear maps satisfying the front/back pure-tensor coordinates of [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree] in their respective degrees. Denote by $\tau_1$ and $\tau_2$ the degree transports into $C^{p+q+1}$ along $(p+1)+q=p+q+1$ and $p+(q+1)=p+q+1$. For all $a\in A^p$ and $b\in B^q$, one has $d_C(h(a\otimes b))=\tau_1(h_1(d_Aa\otimes b))+(-1)^p\tau_2(h_2(a\otimes d_Bb))$. No covering, finiteness, separatedness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose bidegree maps in every degree using the proved bidegree existence theorem. Their prescribed coordinates uniquely determine their pure-tensor values by injectivity of the Cech coordinate equivalence; hence the chosen maps agree with each of h, h₁ and h₂ on the pure tensors used in the conclusion. The choice supplies no arbitrary coefficient data.

Apply the existing inclusion-level differential compatibility theorem to this family in degree p+q. Recover its bidegree maps by the degree-map inclusion formula. Expand the total differential into its two terms using Mathlib mapBifunctor.d_eq, ι_D₁, ι_D₂, d₁_eq and d₂_eq; the signs are 1 and (-1)^p. Evaluate on a pure tensor, use the tensor morphism application formulas, and replace the three chosen pure-tensor values with h, h₁ and h₂. These steps preserve the degree transports appearing in the statement.

theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (h₁ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X (p + 1))).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X ((p + 1) + q))
    (h₂ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X (q + 1)) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + (q + 1)))
    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
    (hh₁ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G (p + 1) q h₁)
    (hh₂ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p (q + 1) h₂)
    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) :
    ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d
        (p + q) (p + q + 1) (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)))
          (h₁ (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).d p (p + 1) a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm))
          (h₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).d q (q + 1) b))
